frontier_contract.screening_rule: The full materialized frontier is exploratory except the fixed H1. Raw rank, raw Pareto membership or a best descriptive cell cannot be reported as Edge; all positive claims require the frozen family-wise sequential inference and later independent validation.

integer_allocator.cap_bound_leftover: remove sleeves at native cap and repeat weighted water-fill until no ticket budget or no capacity; retain any unspendable cash
integer_allocator.concurrency: all sleeve tickets for an issue are funded before that issue's outcomes; no payout recycling, deposit, loan, or top-up
integer_allocator.gate_b_requirement: settle each allocated ticket with native per-ticket tax; fail closed if no exact ticket-level settlement bridge exists
integer_allocator.minimum: budget under ¥2 or all native requests zero is NO_BET, zero flow not a loss
integer_allocator.raw_ticket_target: iterative normalized sleeve weight × remaining ticket budget, hard-capped at native requested tickets
integer_allocator.rounding: each water-fill pass floors capped quotas, then gives one residual ticket to largest fractional quota; ties sleeve_id ascending

modes.NATIVE_REQUEST_CONTROL: fraction must equal 1; mode_notional=sum(native requested ticket caps) × ¥2, reduced only for a current-bankroll shortfall
modes.SCALED_NATIVE_REQUEST: exploratory only: mode_notional=fraction × sum(native requested ticket caps) × ¥2; never an accepted native baseline

methodology_contract.M_rule: UPSTREAM_FROZEN_FIXED: FULL=2187, MODEL=512, Q=192. No new M scan or post-outcome M choice. FULL is an indivisible whole-native block; partial Q/MODEL funding must use the prefix registry or abstain.

attribution.covariance: report cross-sleeve concurrent issue covariance and diversification attribution separately from within-sleeve ticket outcomes
attribution.stage4: attribute size/downscale/cash/weight lift against the same-sleeve native-request and equal-weight controls; do not mislabel it as selection, direction, or ticket-construction lift
attribution.upstream: report each inherited Stage-1→3 sleeve path unchanged at native request alongside its actual Stage-4 funded flow

bootstrap.draw: common deterministic issue-resample matrix paired across every portfolio

methodology_contract.membership: all seven nonempty subsets of the three exhaustive ELIGIBLE_COMPLETE_NONREDUNDANT sleeves; historic grids are lineage evidence, not new Stage-4 sleeves; no Stage 1–3 selection, direction, ticket, M, seed, or support construction changes

multiplicity.frontier_status: all non-primary catalog combinations are exploratory/descriptive; raw Pareto or best-cell rank is never Edge evidence
multiplicity.negative_rule: negative/no-promotion results report full frontier and may use proportionate descriptive evidence
multiplicity.positive_inference: 20,000 paired stationary-block bootstrap max-T family-wise adjusted lower bounds at alpha=0.05; test all candidate-minus-control lifts within each frozen family
multiplicity.winner_rule: screen all cells, but no ladder advancement unless the preregistered H1 or a family-wise adjusted candidate passes strict matched PI review

primary_hypothesis.comparison: absolute pre-tax ¥100k path plus matched lift versus B170 BEST_FULL/FULL on exact common support and actual funding convention
primary_hypothesis.decision: a positive claim requires paired sequential lower bound >0, all primary support/capital controls, and later independent held-out/forward validation

sequential_inference.iid_diagnostic: IID issue bootstrap is ROI-only diagnostic and must not support bankroll, drawdown, recovery, dynamic-weight or compounded-growth claims
sequential_inference.moving_block_sensitivity: paired moving block bootstrap, block lengths 6, 12 and 20 chronological issues; full state replay
sequential_inference.path_bootstrap: paired stationary block bootstrap, 20,000 replicates, expected block length 12 issues, seed 192001, each candidate/control shares exact resampled blocks and replays the complete state machine
sequential_inference.primary_estimand: original strict chronological walk-forward replay; recompute weights, funding, cash, equity, drawdown and all state inside every replay

weight_model.PRIOR_ERC: start equal; multiplicative risk-contribution iteration w_i←normalize(w_i×target_RC/RC_i), max 5000 iterations, convergence max|RC-target|<=1e-12
weight_model.constraints: long-only weights, each >=0, sum exactly 1; current issue is never in history
weight_model.covariance: unbiased sample covariance of 52 common active issue returns, then 10% diagonal shrinkage
weight_model.fallback_action: EQUAL_WEIGHT with explicit per-issue fallback reason
weight_model.history: strictly prior chronological full-calendar issues. NO_BET/unavailable stays a zero-flow path row but is absent from active-return samples. Dynamic methods require 52 most-recent common active observations for every participating sleeve.
weight_model.issue_return: pre-tax sleeve net / actual sleeve stake; only actual stake > ¥0 produces an active observation

formulas: all comparisons require identical issue support, mode, fraction, starting capital, available bankroll and actual funding convention
publish absolute path and lift together; blank lift if exact matching is impossible
ladder_decision=ADVANCES only after strict matched PI terminal review

YEAR/FOLD replays retain chronological order within subset; LOYO removes every issue from one year then recomputes state; ex-largest issue/year removes the largest signed pre-tax-net contributor (year aggregates first); decision panels use same full-calendar zero-flow convention
minimum_bankroll=min(preissue_bankroll,postissue_bankroll) over full 348 calendar
minimum_required_start is smallest b found by deterministic integer-yuan bisection for zero unfundable non-NO_BET requests under same policy
ruin_flag=1 iff any postissue_bankroll < ¥2 while a positive native request exists
pre_tax_roi=sum(pre_tax_net)/sum(actual_stake); blank if zero actual stake
each headline candidate receives survivor/search, leakage, support, turnover/cash, covariance fitting, largest issue/year, payout cluster and simple-control tests
cash-only smoothing is separately labeled risk reduction, never diversification edge
downside_correlation=corr(min(r_left,0),min(r_right,0)) over common active returns; blank for <2/nonpositive variance
tail_co_loss_count=count both returns in their own prior 10% lower tail
diversification_attribution=portfolio pre-tax net minus sum(weighted matched standalone nets), reported separately from retained cash
loss=pre_tax_net<0; miss=actual_stake>0 and pre_tax_gross=0; calendar streak includes zero-flow rows, active streak skips zero-flow rows
rolling loss W=sum(min(pre_tax_net,0)) over trailing calendar W={5,10,20}; report worst and frequency
drawdown=running equity peak minus postissue bankroll; duration/time-under-water count chronological issues below peak; recovery is first later issue reaching former peak, blank if absent

near_ruin_flag=1 iff min bankroll < ¥2×max native issue ticket count; sharpe=mean calendar bank return/sample sd×sqrt(issue frequency/year), sortino divides by downside RMS, calmar=annualized compounded bank return/max drawdown fraction; blank where denominator zero
actual_stake=sum(actual ticket count)×¥2
postissue_bankroll=preissue_bankroll+pre_tax_net
turnover=cumulative actual_stake
all sleeve flows in an issue fund concurrently
weights use only issues strictly before issue_instance
fallback_rate=count(non-primary estimator_status)/348
NO_BET/unavailable excluded from active observation but retained as capital zero flow
